title.zh: Former FTX Europe Head’s Perpetuals com Files to Trade Tokenized U.S. Stocks Und
title.en: Former FTX Europe Head’s Perpetuals com Files to Trade Tokenized U.S. Stocks Und

current_state.zh: Perpetuals.com, led by former FTX Europe head Patrick Gruhn, filed with the SEC to operate a tokenized U.S. stock trading venue under the agency's five-year Innovation Exemption, with permissioned AMM pools on its Kronos X L2 and USDC settlement, targeting a possible mid-November launch.
